I'm sorry, this is your third message about this and it's been a week with no movement. That's frustrating, and I'm escalating your case to a Support Lead now because the same issue has been raised three or more times.

Policy says that when tracking hasn't moved for 4 business days, we open a courier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days. If the parcel turns out to be lost, you can choose either a free replacement or a full refund.

I can't promise a faster outcome than that myself, but the Support Lead can review your case. Could you send me your order number so it's attached to the escalation?
